changeSet.sql: create or alter function [dbo].[GetIntersectTypeNames] ( @id int ) returns table as return ( select coalesce(S.Name, S_R.Name, '') + ' [' + coalesce(P.Name,'/') + '] ' + COALESCE(O.Name, O_R.Name, '') as Name from IntersectType I inner join [Predicate] P on P.ID = I.PredicateID left join AssetType S on S.ID = I.SubjectAssetTypeID left join AssetType S_R on S_R.Class = 9 and S_R.ObjectId = 0 and I.SubjectAssetTypeID = 0 and S_R.Class = I.SubjectClass left join AssetType O on O.ID = I.ObjectAssetTypeID left join AssetType O_R on O_R.Class = 9 and O_R.ObjectId = 0 and I.ObjectAssetTypeID = 0 and O_R.Class = I.ObjectClass where I.ID = @id )
changeSet.rollback:
CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[GetIntersectTypeNames] ( @id int ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( SELECT COALESCE(SI.Name, SRef.Name, SATT.Name, '') + ' [' + coalesce(P.Name,'/') + '] ' + COALESCE(ORef.Name, OATT.Name, '') as Name FROM [IntersectType] I left join AssetType SATT on SATT.[Object] = I.Subject and SATT.[ObjectID] = I.SubjectID left join AssetType OATT on OATT.[Object] = I.[Object] and OATT.[ObjectID] = I.ObjectID left join ( SELECT I_sub.ID, COALESCE( SATT_sub.Name, '') + ' [' + coalesce(P_sub.Name,'/') + '] ' + COALESCE( OATT_sub.Name, '') as Name FROM [IntersectType] I_sub left join AssetType SATT_sub on SATT_sub.[Object] = I_sub.Subject and SATT_sub.[ObjectID] = I_sub.SubjectID left join AssetType OATT_sub on OATT_sub.[Object] = I_sub.[Object] and OATT_sub.[ObjectID] = I_sub.ObjectID left join [Predicate] P_sub on P_sub.ID = I_sub.PredicateID
) SI on (I.Subject = 'IntersectType' and SI.ID = I.SubjectID)
left join ( select 0 as ID, 'Reference Item Type' as Name ) SRef on I.Subject = 'ReferenceItemType' and I.SubjectID = 0
left join ( select 0 as ID, 'Reference Item Type' as Name ) ORef on I.Object = 'ReferenceItemType' and I.ObjectID = 0 left join [Predicate] P on P.ID = I.PredicateID WHERE I.ID = @id )
